description:
*Position is contingent upon contract award* 
 SOSi is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to support our government customer in Chantilly, VA.
 Essential Job Duties 
 Serves as a key technical resource for advanced AI/ML architecture, responsible AI implementation, and enterprise-scale model deployment strategies.
 Define AI strategies and roadmaps supporting TRL progression from research to operational deployment.
 
 Active in scope TS/SCI w/ Poly.
 Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience.
 Deep expertise in neural networks, reinforcement learning, model interpretability, and production of MLOps pipelines.
 Experience in productionizing data science research capabilities and analytics, with a focus on transforming these into enterprise-ready applications including AI/ML and deep learning models with GPU.
 
 Work Environment 
 Normal office conditions.
 Working at SOSi 
 All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.
